name: Windmill
flavor: Mills wheat into food. One wheat makes 5 food, then 7, 9 and 11 with upgrades.

name: Charcoal Kiln
flavor: Turns wood into coal for steam engines and the power plant.

name: Stone Grinder
flavor: Crushes stone into iron for track, signals and machines.

name: Oil Refinery
flavor: Makes oil from coal and water for diesel engines.

name: Power Plant
flavor: Burns fuel with wood and water to make power. Connect power lines to it.

name: Substation
flavor: Taps the pole grid and feeds the wires within six tiles. Too many trains under one and they all slow together.

name: Hydro Plant
flavor: Turbines in the river. No fuel, twice a coal plant's output, but only where the water is.

name: Wooden Bridge
flavor: Timber trusses form connected spans beneath straight rails. Build platforms on water, then lay any track. Above 80% of capacity trains cross at half speed; overweight trains find another route.

name: Stone Bridge
flavor: Masonry arches form connected spans beneath straight rails. Build platforms on water, then lay any track. Above 80% of capacity trains cross at half speed; overweight trains find another route.
